method: Wins only. Every 2026 rated win was scored for upsets (200+ rating gap), material comebacks, fastest and prettiest mates, low-clock wins and possible sacrifices; the top candidates were re-analysed with local Stockfish 17.1 at depth 13. Sacrifices count only when Stockfish rates the move best or within 0.4 pawns of best. Games with an unpunished blunder of 3+ pawns were dropped unless the escape itself is the story. 'Engine-approved' is our own Stockfish check, not a Chess.com 'Brilliant' tag.
